notes.title: CLeM Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It’s been almost 2 years since we revealed CLeM, the fourth game in the Psychotic Adventures series, to the world. Now, we're thrilled to announce that the game is set to release on February 6th, 2024! 

To mark this occasion, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer that’ll take you into the mystical world of CLeM! Check it out!

[previewyoutube=BuiYImHSR9o;full]https://youtu.be/BuiYImHSR9o[/previewyoutube]

We’ve also decided on a price point for the game: $15.99. In addition, we’ll be adding a 10% discount on launch day!

We want to send a massive, heartfelt thank you to all those who’ve been following and supporting CLeM up to this point! As we close in on the crucial release phase that will determine CLeM's success, we invite you to join our Discord and contribute to making it as successful as possible!

We hope that you are as excited about the imminent release of CLeM as we are! 

Wishlist the game now!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861440/CLeM/

notes.title: Update 14: IT'S TIME
notes.notes:
Join forces with Nika, MechaNika, Agatha and the Great Bleeding Pig in Colossus Down, a unique and twisted mission of destruction of everything that isn't cool.

[previewyoutube=ooZmo73Fxa4;full][/previewyoutube]

Bringing this game to life has been quite a ride and we can't wait for you to discover our new Psychotic Adventure. We'd love to know what decisions you make and what outcomes you face throughout the game. Your experience, what you feel and what you think of it means a lot to us. So, please, feel free to share your thoughts about the game on social networks and leaving a review on Steam. That will help us A LOT!

notes.title: Update 13: World of Warfare Recycled Edition 2078
notes.notes:
Duty Call MMMLVI, Assassin's Greed XIX, FIFO Super Cup, even more battle royales, a bunch of new youpipers...

Nika despises what the world of gaming has become. It's time for a remake! Well, more of a reboot. But... 

Anyway. Enjoy your World of Warfare Recycled Edition 2078. With a fat Day-1 patch and "surprise mechanics". Or get Colossus Down and change it all.

notes.title: Update 05: Codename Colossus Down
notes.notes:
[img]https://s7.postimg.org/ideg9slqz/colossus_down_reveal_twitter.gif[/img]

We are working on our new game, codenamed [b]Colossus Down[/b]. It's a funepic action game featuring MechaNika, the robot of mass destruction that Nika built in the first Psychotic Adventure. There's no release date yet, but we can't wait to share some details of the game with you all. We'll be posting some concept art, animations and gameplay clips as we progress, so make sure you follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MangoProtocol]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/mangoprotocol/]Facebook[/url] if you want to stay up to date!

Oh, and to celebrate this awesome news MechaNika is 75% off for a limited time only, so make sure you and all the people around you has contributed to Nika's plan, because if you don't... 

[b]SHE WILL COME FOR YOU[/b].



http://store.steampowered.com/app/384680/MechaNika/

notes.title: Update 04: Now Agatha speaks French too!
notes.notes:
Thanks to our friend Olivier Busière, who already worked with us on the localization for MechaNika, now you can also play Agatha Knife in French. Merci beaucoup, Olivier!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28513848/66d5bf211c4feb58f20d8f29e343a59cd117527c.jpg[/img]

Agatha Knife has already been fully localized to English, Spanish, Catalan, German, Russian and French, but we'd like to reach the widest audience possible, so if you want to contribute with a new translation, please, drop us an email and let's make it happen!

notes.title: Update 01: It's time to believe in Carnivorism
notes.notes:
She loves animals and adores meat. And she's almost here.

[img]https://s30.postimg.org/hrqeyb4bl/agatha_knife_launch_gif.gif[/img]

Agatha Knife will be released on April 27th on Steam for Windows, Mac OS X and Linux. You will be able to create your own religion in English, Spanish and Catalan, but the localisation team is working hard on German, French and Russian translations, so they may be released soon after if not on launch date. 

Thanks for your support and get your faith ready, because it's time to believe.
